'''Salline''' was a location on the [[planet]] [[Chandrila]].<ref name="Rebel Files" /> In [[27 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' dates the ''[[Bormea Today]]'' interview to eight [[Standard year|years]] before the [[proclamation of the New Order]]. As ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the proclamation to [[19 BBY]], the interview must have taken place in [[27 BBY]].</ref> the publication ''[[Bormea Today]]'' conducted an interview in Salline with local sensation [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]], who had recently been elected to represent Chandrila in the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Galactic Senate]].<ref name="Rebel Files" />

==Behind the scenes==
Salline was first mentioned in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2018]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="Rebel Files" /> It originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first mentioned in the [[2014]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', which was also written by Wallace.<ref name="Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>
